description: Determine whether a string is a palindrome.
instructions: Implement a function named is_palindrome that accepts a string and returns True if it reads the same forward and backward, ignoring capitalization and spaces. Do not ignore punctuation.

input: A man a plan a canal Panama

instructions: Implement a function named reverse_string that accepts a string and returns its characters in reverse order.
Implement a function named count_vowels that accepts a string and returns the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) it contains. The count must be case-insensitive. Treat y as a consonant.

description: Find the largest number in a list.
instructions: Implement a function named find_max that accepts a non-empty list of numbers and returns the largest number. You may assume the list contains at least one number.

description: Remove duplicate elements while preserving order.
instructions: Implement a function named remove_duplicates that accepts a list of integers and returns a new list containing each distinct value only once, preserving the order of its first occurrence.

description: Count the frequency of words in a string.
instructions: Implement a function named word_frequency that accepts a string and returns a dictionary mapping each word to its frequency. Words are separated by whitespace, and matching must be case-insensitive. Do not remove punctuation. An empty or whitespace-only string should return an empty dictionary.

description: Find two indices whose values add up to a target.
instructions: Implement a function named two_sum that accepts a list of integers and a target integer. Return a list containing the indices of the first pair of distinct elements whose values sum to the target. Search pairs by increasing first index, then increasing second index. If no pair exists, return None.
Implement a function named fibonacci that accepts a non-negative integer n and returns the nth Fibonacci number using zero-based indexing. Define F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, and F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2).

Implement a function named flatten_list that accepts a list containing integers and other nested lists of the same structure. Return a new one-dimensional list containing all integers in their original left-to-right order. Nested lists may have arbitrary depth.

description: Determine whether an integer is prime.
instructions: Implement a function named is_prime that accepts an integer and returns True if it is a prime number, otherwise False. A prime number is an integer greater than 1 with exactly two positive divisors: 1 and itself.
